Note: these official community locations exist only in NHA/BMA registers — slums are not a zoning category in the ผังเมืองรวม (comprehensive plans).

Data sources

  • NHA low-income communities (1,588 points) — National Housing Authority open data, gdcatalog dataset 23_01. House / population figures are modeled (log-normal, calibrated to official NHA/CODI aggregates), not surveyed.
  • Comprehensive-plan zones (ผังเมืองรวม) — BMA City Planning Division comprehensive plan land-use zones, Bangkok plan (cityplangis.bangkok.go.th; see Data match).
  • BMA khet (district) boundaries — Bangkok Metropolitan Administration open data (data.bangkok.go.th).
  • Nationwide amphoe / tambon outlines — NGIS / DOPA administrative vector layers (same data/districts.js, data/tambons.js as the main map).
  • AI-detected building footprints & slum-group blobs (red / pink / orange overlays) — project pipeline: SAM (MobileSAM) + U-Net roof segmentation on a GISTDA THEOS-2 scene, U-Net trained against Overture teacher footprints; v11 slum-group rule (small-building density, spacing, canal/road/rail/industrial corridor proximity). Method: Gen 1 · Gen 2 · Gen 3.
  • Overture building footprints (gen-2 teacher labels) — Overture Maps Foundation.
  • Canal / road / rail / industrial corridors — OpenStreetMap via Overpass API.
  • Satellite imagery — GISTDA THEOS-2 ortho (GeoHackathon 2026 NGIS platform, geohackathon.gistda.or.th).
  • Basemaps — Google satellite; Esri World Imagery; © OpenStreetMap contributors; CARTO light.

Scientific references

  • Abascal, J. et al. (2022) '“Domains of deprivation” framework for mapping slums, informal settlements, and other deprived areas in LMICs', Habitat International, 123, 102776. Link
  • Roy, D., Bernal, D. and Lees, M. (2020) 'An exploratory factor analysis model for slum severity index in Mexico City', Urban Studies, 57(4), 797–819. Link
  • United Nations Statistics Division (2023) SDG indicator 11.1.1 metadata: proportion of urban population living in slums or informal settlements. PDF
  • World Food Programme (2023) Multidimensional Deprivation Index (Alkire-Foster counting method). Link
  • Ronneberger, O., Fischer, P. and Brox, T. (2015) 'U-Net: Convolutional networks for biomedical image segmentation', MICCAI 2015. arXiv:1505.04597
  • Kirillov, A. et al. (2023) 'Segment Anything', ICCV 2023. arXiv:2304.02643
